title: Finite evaluation of tensor and system compactification projection
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, coefficient datum C, finite extension E, n≥1, a normalized six-functor datum d, a level m≥0, invertibility of the coefficient prime, and realized coefficient-system operations o,z. There exists a natural tensor comparison e as in [def-sf-integral-projection-finite-evaluation-data]. For every separated locally finite-type quasi-compact f:X→Y, compactification c and constructible integral K,L, the evaluated system projection endpoints have isomorphisms s,r to the finite partial-tensor/support endpoints. Under s the evaluated explicit sourceMap of [def-sf-integral-projection-coordinate-data] equals reductionEvaluation followed by sourceIso; under r the evaluated targetMap equals reductionEvaluation followed by targetIso; and the evaluated system compactificationProjection followed by r equals s followed by the specified finite component. The tensor coordinates in both endpoint equations are the components of e. No integral projection map occurs in these assertions.

source.place: Compatibility of the specified maps under successive coefficient reductions; integral reconstruction and proper counit normalization

proof.text: Choose the ambient system tensor evaluation b and its proper/open projection equation. Construct e by lifting its evaluated datum tensor comparison through the full finite inclusion; no data is selected from an unproved theorem in a definition.

Take the explicit evaluatedSource and evaluatedTarget as s and r. Apply tensor naturality to the unary support-evaluation square. The constructed tensor-lift equation then proves the source endpoint identity. Apply tensor naturality to the unary pull-evaluation square and cancel the tensor input comparison. Naturality of supportEvaluation and finiteSupport, followed by the support-evaluation square on the tensor input, proves the target endpoint identity.
The third endpoint identity is precisely the system projection evaluation equation in these explicit source and target coordinates.

theorem integralProjectionFiniteEvaluation
    {D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}} {C : D.CoefficientDatum}
    {E : Type u} [Field E] [Algebra (Padic C.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E] {n : ℕ} {hn : 1 ≤ n}
    (d : SixFunctorOperationDatum D C E n hn) (m : ℕ)
    (hl : IsUnit (C.l : D.k)) (o : Operations C.l E) (z : Realizations C.l E D o) :
    ∃ e : TensorComparison d m,
      ∀ {X Y : SixFunctorSpace D} (f : X ⟶ Y)
        [IsSeparated f.hom.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType f.hom.left] [QuasiCompact f.hom.left]
        (c : Compactification f.hom.left)
        (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E X.obj.left)
        (L : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E Y.obj.left),
        let t := tensorCoordinates d m e
        let ev := evaluation (C := C) (E := E) m Y
        let I := finiteInclusion (C := C) (E := E) m Y
        let KF := (reduction d m X).obj K
        let LF := (torReduction d m Y).obj L
        let T := CompactSupportFiniteProjection.partialTensor (stage d m)
        let A := ((d.higher.integralTensor Y).obj
          ((d.higher.integral.support f c).obj K)).obj L
        let B := (d.higher.integral.support f c).obj
          (((d.higher.integralTensor X).obj K).obj ((d.higher.integral.pull f).obj L))
        ∃ (s : ev.obj (systemSource o f c K L) ≅
            I.obj (((T Y).obj (((stage d m).finite.support f c).obj KF)).obj LF))
          (r : ev.obj (systemTarget o f c K L) ≅
            I.obj (((stage d m).finite.support f c).obj
              (((T X).obj KF).obj
                ((CompactSupportFiniteProjection.torPull (stage d m) f).obj LF)))),
          ev.map (FixProjectionCompactification.Coordinates.sourceMap
              D C E d.higher hl o z f c K L) ≫ s.hom =
            (reductionEvaluation d m Y A).hom ≫ I.map (sourceIso d m t f c K L).hom ∧
          ev.map (FixProjectionCompactification.Coordinates.targetMap
              D C E d.higher hl o z f c K L) ≫ r.hom =
            (reductionEvaluation d m Y B).hom ≫ I.map (targetIso d m t f c K L).hom ∧
          ev.map (compactificationProjection C.l E o z.compositors z.openComparisons c
              ((calculus C.l E X.obj.left).reduction.obj K.obj)
              ((calculus C.l E Y.obj.left).reduction.obj L.obj)) ≫ r.hom =
            s.hom ≫ I.map (CompactSupportFiniteProjection.component (stage d m) f c
              KF LF)
